title: Add synthetic paraphrase prober and consistency SLO enforcer
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a CI-on-change hook that probes prompt sets with synthetic paraphrases and enforces a configurable consistency SLO. No user-facing API changes.
description: Motivation: We intermittently see downstream regressions when models change but our prompt sets are brittle to surface-level paraphrases. This PR introduces a lightweight synthetic paraphrase prober and a consistency SLO enforcer that runs as a CI hook. The prober generates paraphrase variants for targeted prompt sets, scores the model's outputs for semantic and ranking stability, and raises a quality gate if a defined per-prompt consistency threshold is violated. Summary of changes: - New module hooks/paraphrase_prober.py: generates paraphrases (back-translation + template perturbations), deduplicates variants, and produces a canonical probe bundle. - New module hooks/consistency_slo.py: scoring and threshold enforcement logic; supports token-edit-distance, embedding-cosine stability, and top-k rank-stability. - CI hook integration .github/workflows/probe-ci.yml that runs fast probes for PRs touching prompt sets or evaluation code. - Tests: tests/test_paraprobe.py, tests/test_consistency_slo.py with deterministic seeds and mocked model API. - Small infra: scripts/probe_cache.py (local caching of generated paraphrases to keep CI cost low) and docs/PROBES.md describing the SLO contract. Design highlights: - Probes are parameterized: sample_size, paraphrase_engine (back-translate or synonym-swap), similarity_metric, and slo_thresholds per cohort. - Scoring: an aggregated consistency score is computed by combining normalized rank-stability (50%), embedding similarity (30%), and normalized token-edit stability (20%). Thresholds are configurable per-prompt-set in eval-configs/consistency-policies.yaml. - Fast-path CI: The workflow does a single-shot cached probe run (default 50 paraphrases across a small representative sample) to keep runtime under 5 minutes for most PRs. - Fallback: On borderline failures the hook posts a diagnostic artifact (HTML with examples) and opens an internal issue template for triage. Checklist: - [x] Prober core implementation - [x] CI workflow and caching - [x] Unit tests and synthetic model mocks - [x] Docs and runbook - [x] Backwards-compatible configs Rollout plan: Feature gated behind eval.probes.enabled; gradual opt-in for critical prompt-sets first (search, summarization, billing messages). If the hook rejects a PR, logs include sample failures and a direct link to re-run with relaxed thresholds locally. Tests and CI: Unit tests cover scoring math, sampling determinism, and caching. Integration smoke in CI uses a lightweight mocked model that returns deterministic paraphrase-preserving outputs; full model-run is gated to nightly runs to avoid quota consumption. Risk and mitigation: False positives from paraphrase generator noise — mitigated by caching, deterministic seeds, and requiring >1 metric to fall below threshold before gating. Performance: Adds ~2-5 minutes to affected PRs; caching reduces repeated cost. Commit summary: - 1a2b3c: add paraphrase prober and paraphrase cache - 2b3c4d: add consistency SLO enforcer and policy config - 3c4d5e: CI workflow and probe artifact publishing - 4d5e6f: unit tests and mocks - 5e6f7g: docs and runbook Examples of changed files (high-level): - hooks/paraphrase_prober.py: new class ParaphraseProber(gen_engine, dedupe=True) with generate(), batch_apply() - hooks/consistency_slo.py: new function evaluate_consistency(bundle, model_client, policy) - .github/workflows/probe-ci.yml: adds conditional probe job triggered on paths: 'eval-configs/**', 'prompts/**', 'hooks/**' - eval-configs/consistency-policies.yaml: policy schema and default thresholds - tests/test_paraprobe.py: unit tests and fixtures - scripts/probe_cache.py: local cache helper - docs/PROBES.md: user-facing guidance How to review: Focus on the scoring math in consistency_slo.py, the policy schema, and the CI performance characteristics. The paraphrase generator is intentionally shallow (back-translate via a small translation model or synonym-swap) to keep noise low. Related work: This complements existing perturbation and fuzz probes but emphasizes paraphrase invariance and per-prompt SLO enforcement. Links: Linear ENG-2145, internal runbook link in docs.

merge_commit_message: Add synthetic paraphrase prober and consistency SLO enforcer (ENG-2145)
post_merge_actions: Feature gated under eval.probes.enabled=false by default; monitoring dashboard added to Console (eval.probes.consistency) and an alert rule (SLO-drop > 3% over 48h) created.
notes_for_ops: If noise spike observed, set eval.probes.enabled=false while investigating. Probe artifacts are stored in the CI artifact store under 'probe-diagnostics'. Triage template in docs/PROBES.md.
manual_test_instructions: Run: python -m hooks.paraphrase_prober --policy eval-configs/consistency-policies.yaml --sample-size 50 --dry-run; then: python -m hooks.consistency_slo --bundle ./cached_bundle.json --model-mock tests/fixtures/mock_model.json --report out.html
examples: Example failure artifact includes original prompt, paraphrase variants, outputs, embedding similarity, rank-stability table, and recommended action (relax threshold / add training example)
